review_notes: I read the whole file. It transfers Functor, LawfulFunctor, Traversable and LawfulTraversable along a family of equivalences `∀ α, t α ≃ t' α`. I grepped Mathlib for other uses of `Equiv.map`, `Equiv.functor`, `Equiv.traversable` and `Equiv.traverse`. The only external use is `Mathlib/Data/DList/Instances.lean`, which uses `Equiv.traversable`. I found no competing transfer mechanism for Functor or Traversable in Mathlib, Batteries or core. `Equiv.map` is specific to this construction, so it does not duplicate `Functor.map`. I did not search Batteries or core exhaustively for a generic functor-transfer construction, so a small uncertainty remains.
